issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: iron_bars, red_wall_banner, stone_brick_wall.

notes.detail: Iron bars in the slits, red banner under the corbels, wall torches on the merlons, a lamp post on the walk.
notes.depth: Front has footing, corbels and slits; the inner (back, z2) face is a flat 5-high slab of brick with only cobble patches.
notes.roof: Joins checked against the shared profile (walk top y4 / stand y5, parapet y5, merlons at even x at y6): both open ends (x0, x4) carry the full body, an open 2-wide walk at z1-z2 and merlons at x0 and x4, so pieces join cleanly. Because the module is 5 wide, every join puts two merlons side by side (x4 + next x0); that is common to all stone_wall_* pieces, not a mismatch.
notes.life: Lantern and torches; no greenery yet.

visual.summary: L1 plus iron bars in the arrow slits, a red wall banner on the front, two wall torches on the inside of the end merlons and a lantern on a wall post mid-walk.
problems: None blocking. The lamp post at x2 z2 y5 narrows the walk to 1 wide there; fine.
